source.quote: SMSL's own page for the D100, read 2026-11-24: « ES9081 DAC, utilizing 8-channel parallel summing to achieve an elite 127dB dynamic range with full MQA, PCM 768kHz, and DSD512 suppor[t] ».

facts.chip: ES9081 (ESS) « utilizing 8-channel parallel summing » - the maker stating that it parallels all of the chip's channels, which classes.json flags as arguably multi-element where the ess_sabre family assumes single.

_one_sentence_only: A single sentence carries the whole record. No input is rated separately and no transport is split.
